### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via DatasetMeasureSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageTabsProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1e1ae74246e912409fef2feaad7f3d0215d8743f` — the merge of head `2a768071114e39151f9231823700d17c39f3b7f3` into base `8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1e1ae74246e912409fef2feaad7f3d0215d8743f && git checkout 1e1ae74246e912409fef2feaad7f3d0215d8743f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07 2a768071114e39151f9231823700d17c39f3b7f3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07 && git merge --no-ff 2a768071114e39151f9231823700d17c39f3b7f3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8cbc3c0084a3c3c8ef5e59763ab3be96aa1a6f07` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3fd40bedd80463437f8435048bdc1c73da14d428`

### ① Derived judgments

- **Executable-surface check — PASS.** Every touched non-test spec file was comment-stripped (block + line comments, strings preserved) at `origin/main` and at the head, and the results diffed:
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (+128/−79): stripped diff EMPTY — every hunk is JSDoc/comment prose (PageTabs, PageAccordion, element:button, metric, kanban, calendar, object-map header, map `filter`/`sort`, gantt, tree, timeline, ComponentPropsMap).
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts`: stripped diff EMPTY.
  - `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`: stripped diff EMPTY (calendar, gantt, timeline, map rows — comment only).
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: against the PR's merge-base `afc3b649` the stripped diff is exactly ONE line — the `FormField.span` `.describe()` at head `:3264`, whose only token change is `87af769e9` → `62597c588`. (Against the `origin/main` tip, extra `columns`/`hiddenFields`/`fieldOrder` describe lines are main drift from `9dcdb775`, landed after the merge-base; `merge-tree` is clean and `mergeable_state` is `clean`.) No schema, default, enum, export or other `.describe()` moved.
  - Migration entries: all six hunks sit inside the `reason:` string; no `id`, key, version or transform changed.
  - `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`: mechanical regeneration — its changed lines are byte-identical to the entries' changed lines modulo indent; nothing else moved against the merge-base.
- **Test files — no assertion weakened.** `component.test.ts` and `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts`: comment-stripped diff EMPTY for both; the edits are `//` citation prose only.
- **Citation spot-checks at objectui `62597c588072`** (full clone; 30+ anchors read, all as claimed), including: the two `view.zod.ts` ObjectMap anchors (`ObjectMap.tsx:404` `ObjectMapConfigSchema.safeParse(config)`, `:409` the style fallback — byte-identical to `:385`/`:390` at `87af`); the calendar row (`ObjectCalendar.tsx:1200` `if (!calendarConfig)` → `:1206-1208` `tt('calendar.configRequired', …)`; `en.ts:711` carries the English sentence, `zh.ts:598` / `de.ts:579` their own; `afb228418` is an ancestor of the new pin and not of the old); the calendar `navigation` read points; `FormField.span` (`autoLayout.ts:154` `resolveColSpan`, `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` identical at both pins, `form.tsx` byte-identical); the grid selection block hashes in `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts`; `dataset.zod.ts` measure `format`; the byte-identity roster; corpus counts re-taken at both pins (dark tokens 0 at both; `onCardClick` = 11 at both — the "6" correction is right).
- **`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`**: only `rev`, `revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` changed; `revDate` equals the new pin's commit date. Grammar untouched.
- **The pin**: `28b065800c7d` (the fail-closed fix) is an ancestor of `62597c588072` (exit 0, non-shallow clone); `87af769e9a3e` is an ancestor of the fix; 33 commits fix → pin. `.objectui-sha` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` carry the full sha.
- **No stale asserting citation**: zero matches of the gate's asserting pattern for the old pin remain in `packages/spec/src`; the one leftover `87af769e9a` in a `.pin.test.ts` is the historical spelling.
- **`Clause-②: no` is right**: no accept-set change, no exported name moved, no public surface widened.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/console-62597c588072.md` → `@objectstack/console: minor`: correct and truthful (30 objectui changesets in range, 0 major; lists the fail-closed fix).
- `.changeset/19503-pin-bump-describe-corrections.md` → `@objectstack/spec: patch`: correct — one describe sentence re-points a pin citation. No major anywhere.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No governed surface and no release-owned tree in the 19-file list.
- `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`: exactly the two `span` rows, generator output only.
- `origin/main` has moved since the merge-base; `merge-tree` is clean; a later re-merge will need `gen:docs` from the merged tree, which the pre-push `os-regen` hook enforces.
- Check-runs on `3fd40bedd`: 42 total, 39 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures.
